description: Office of the Public Service Commission - Service Minute of the Sri Lanka Agriculture Service - 5th Amendment
categorisation: This gazette content pertains to amendments to the Service Minute of the Sri Lanka Agriculture Service, specifically detailing promotion procedures, interview processes, and selection criteria for various agricultural service positions. It is issued by the Public Service Commission, which deals with public sector administration, recruitment, and service conditions, making it a clear example of a Public Service Gazette.
